name: HP/Agilent 34401A 6.5-digit multimeter
description: Function, range, NPLC and running min/max/avg. No outputs.

quirks.note: In LOCAL the meter answers *IDN? and CONF? but refuses READ? with +550 -- it looks like a dead measurement. REN must be asserted; the core does it on every connect.
SYST:LOC is RS-232 only (+514 over GPIB).
NPLC is integration time: an accuracy control with a speed side-effect, not a fast/slow switch.
No battery and no *SAV/*RCL. Powers up in DC volts, autorange; only interface/language settings persist.
9.9E37 is the overload value, not a reading.

author: Systemstech

function.doc: Choose the measurement function. Resets the statistics and returns the range to AUTO.
function.scpi: CONF:VOLT:DC | CONF:VOLT:AC | CONF:CURR:DC | CONF:CURR:AC | CONF:RES | CONF:FRES | CONF:FREQ | CONF:PER | CONF:DIOD | CONF:CONT; TRIG:SOUR IMM

range.doc: Set the range of the present function, or AUTO. Not for FREQ/PERIOD/DIODE/CONT.

value.doc: "AUTO" or a number in the function's units, e.g. "10" for the 10 V range

nplc.doc: Integration time in power-line cycles: an ACCURACY control (10 = best noise rejection, slowest).

reset_stats.doc: Zero min/max/avg/samples. Use before averaging fresh readings.

clear_errors.doc: Read and empty the error queue. Reply: errors = the list read.

manual.title: HP 34401A Multimeter User's Guide
manual.pages: ref = the page number printed on the page, not the PDF viewer's page

unit.doc: VDC, VAC, ADC, AAC, OHM, Hz, s or V

function.doc: the function name as in the function action

avg.doc: mean of the readings since reset_stats

samples.doc: readings since reset_stats (wait_for this to average n fresh ones)

last_error.doc: first error read by the last clear_errors

functions.doc: the function names this card offers
